## Perfect Execution

From a pitcher's perspective, there's nothing sweeter than a clean sheet. Today we went 1-0, hitting 100% on our calls. When you trust your reads and stick to the game plan, this is what happens. The Guardians came through exactly as we projected.

## Breaking Down the Win

Guardians at Sox was the only game on the slate, and we called it straight down the middle at 50% probability. Sometimes the matchup tells you it's a coin flip, and you have to trust the intangibles. Cleveland's pitching depth and bullpen management gave them the edge when it mattered most.

## The Pitcher's Read

Even at 50-50 odds, there are always tells if you know where to look. The Guardians' rotation has been working ahead in counts all season, and their defense doesn't beat itself. When the game's on the line, those fundamentals matter more than raw stuff. That's what separated these teams today.
